Validated Diagram Generation
|-- [M] Modular structure: orchestration -> generation / domain revisions / canvas ports
|   |-- Request orchestration
|   |   |-- DiagramEditService exposes start, get, wait, cancel, dispose
|   |   |   `-- Keeps run records, request signatures, generation and installation internal
|   |   `-- DiagramBatchService exposes start, has, get, wait, cancel, dispose
|   |       `-- Depends on DiagramEditService to prepare each operation
|   |-- Generation boundary
|   |   |-- generateDiagram depends on the DiagramGenerator port + revision store
|   |   |-- PiDiagramEditRuntime implements DiagramGenerator
|   |   |   `-- Depends on PiAgentRuntime, prompt rendering and validated submission
|   |   `-- FakeDiagramEditRuntime implements the same port without a model session
|   |-- Domain boundary
|   |   `-- Imported validators and revision-store operations
|   |       `-- Check edits/scopes/reviews and issue revisions before canvas installation
|   |-- Canvas boundary
|   |   |-- DiagramEditCanvasPort: snapshot, apply, optional create
|   |   `-- Batch service additionally requires batch
|   `-- Reusable workflow boundary: runAgentWorkflow
|       |-- Feature supplies steps, prompts, before hooks and validation
|       |-- Executor owns session/tool execution and returns an accepted submission
|       `-- Available abstraction; no invocation from the supplied diagram runtime
|-- [C] Request execution: prepare -> validate -> issue revision -> install -> acknowledge
|   |-- 1. DiagramEditService.start
|   |   |-- Validate operation options, context identity and template
|   |   |-- Look up (sessionId, requestId)
|   |   |   |-- Different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |   |-- Same signature -> return retained run state
|   |   |   `-- Same signature + awaiting-acknowledgement + no pending work
|   |   |       `-- Relaunch installation using prepared output; no model rerun
|   |   `-- New request -> record generating run -> launch generate
|   |-- 2. Capture and pin inputs
|   |   |-- canvas.snapshot(target revision + reference revisions)
|   |   |-- Check expected document version and current target base revision
|   |   |-- Import exact revisions and logical node identities
|   |   |-- Resolve references to pinned text or selected-node excerpts
|   |   |-- Resolve edit ranges; variant refinement retains its saved scope
|   |   `-- Load matching bound agent context when eligible; validate extension anchors
|   |-- 3. Produce a domain revision
|   |   |-- Supplied edit -> submitStoredDiagramEdit directly
|   |   `-- Generated edit -> generateDiagram
|   |       |-- Check base belongs to the requested diagram
|   |       |-- Clone request with base nodeRefs -> DiagramGenerator.generate
|   |       |   `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime.generate
|   |       |       |-- Require enabled AI and an available, authenticated model
|   |       |       |-- Render captured context; resolve imported agent-context sources
|   |       |       |-- Create session with submit_diagram_edit as its tool
|   |       |       `-- session.prompt -> submit_diagram_edit(candidate)
|   |       |           |-- Invalid edit or replacement scope -> report issues
|   |       |           |   `-- terminate=false; agent can correct and resubmit
|   |       |           `-- Valid -> retain candidate; terminate=true
|   |       |               `-- Require accepted submission, revalidate, return candidate
|   |       `-- Check cancellation -> submitStoredDiagramEdit -> issued revision
|   |-- 4. Install according to operation
|   |   |-- In-place edit -> canvas.apply(prepared revision)
|   |   |   `-- Pass original expectedVersion + baseRevisionId to mutation boundary
|   |   |-- Variant edit -> generate requested alternatives sequentially
|   |   |   |-- Validate review records; optionally attach presentation alternatives
|   |   |   `-- canvas.apply(revision + prepared variants)
|   |   `-- Create / extend -> prepare new diagrams -> place
|   |       |-- Create uses requested count; extend produces one diagram
|   |       |-- Read latest canvas; revalidate extension anchors
|   |       |-- Use explicit origin or compute placement beside anchor
|   |       `-- canvas.create with stable run ID as requestId
|   |           `-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> refresh placement and retry, at most 3 attempts
|   |-- 5. Distinguish generation from application acknowledgement
|   |   |-- Receipt -> completed; expose document version and operation results
|   |   |-- Applying + CANVAS_TIMEOUT / CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE / PERSISTENCE_PENDING
|   |   |   `-- awaiting-acknowledgement -> retry installation on matching start
|   |   |-- VERSION_CONFLICT after applicable retries -> conflict
|   |   `-- Other errors -> failed; cancellation before application -> cancelled
|   `-- Batch entry: DiagramBatchService.start
|       |-- Validate schema and request identity -> capture one shared snapshot
|       |-- Reject multiple edits targeting the same logical diagram
|       |-- For each operation, sequentially start and await a child edit service
|       |   |-- Child snapshot adapter preserves the shared document version
|       |   |-- Child apply/create adapters collect edits and creations
|       |   `-- Child completion means prepared; real canvas batch is still pending
|       `-- All children succeed -> retain application -> canvas.batch once
|           |-- Receipt updates all result versions -> completed
|           `-- Ambiguous application -> awaiting-acknowledgement
|               `-- Matching retry resends retained batch; children do not regenerate
|-- [O] Ownership: retained requests and temporary execution resources
|   |-- Edit service owns each Run
|   |   |-- Cloned input, signature, status, AbortController and pending promise
|   |   |-- Prepared revision / variants / creations survive uncertain application
|   |   |-- Current and next agent-context snapshots remain associated with the run
|   |   |-- get/start return cloned state; pending promise is cleared on settlement
|   |   `-- cancel/dispose abort generating runs only; dispatched application is not cancelled
|   |-- Batch service owns child tracking, collected results and prepared application
|   |   |-- Cancellation while generating propagates to the active child
|   |   `-- Successful preparation clears child tracking before real batch application
|   |-- Both services retain request/run maps in memory
|   |   `-- Each rejects new runs at 500; no completed-run eviction is shown
|   |-- PiAgentRuntime owns a cached ModelRuntime promise and active-session set
|   |   |-- Creates disk-backed session managers for auditable session history
|   |   `-- Runtime disposal aborts/disposes tracked sessions and clears the set
|   |-- PiDiagramEditRuntime owns one generation session's listeners
|   |   |-- Abort signal -> session.abort
|   |   `-- finally -> remove abort listener, unsubscribe, dispose session, untrack it
|   `-- Validated-submission closure owns its accepted candidate
|       `-- Workflow runner owns previous output; executor retains session/tool responsibility
`-- [D] Data dependency: what an acknowledged result requires
    |-- Prepared revision [shared R]
    |   |-- Accepted candidate: ASCII, structure kind, optional mappings/replacement ranges
    |   |   |-- Generated path needs instruction + selected template/options
    |   |   |-- Captured base, editable ranges, logical nodeRefs and canvas connections
    |   |   |-- Pinned reference revisions -> exact text/excerpts and node labels
    |   |   `-- Optional agent context -> resolved sources and imported messages
    |   |-- Base revision + diagram identity + source binding/evidence
    |   `-- Domain submission/validation -> revision identity and stored result
    |-- Edit acknowledgement
    |   `-- [shared R] + target node + original base/version + stable requestId -> apply receipt
    |-- Creation acknowledgement
    |   `-- [shared R] content + latest placement/version + optional source anchors -> create receipt
    |-- Batch acknowledgement
    |   `-- All prepared operations + shared expectedVersion + stable requestId -> batch receipt
    `-- Shared dependencies persist across acknowledgement retries
        `-- Reuse prepared output; a new receipt does not require a new model result
